name: Premium Silicone Baby Feeding Set (6-Piece) – BPA-Free, Suction Base & Ergonomic Design for Self-Feeding
description: Transitioning to solid foods is a major milestone, and our Premium Silicone Baby Feeding Set is designed to support your little one every step of the way. Crafted from 100% food-grade, BPA-free silicone, this set is gentle on developing gums while being tough enough to withstand daily use.The set includes a divided suction plate to keep food groups separate and a deep suction bowl with a curved lip to help toddlers scoop food easily. The adjustable silicone bib features a wide crumb catcher pocket to keep outfits clean. To support hydration, the double-handle straw cup provides a secure grip for small hands.
